Your Role in Our Mission
As a Trading Platform Engineer (MetaTrader), you will ensure the stability, reliability, and performance of our MetaTrader-based CFD and brokerage trading platforms. You will work at the intersection of trading technology, infrastructure, and DevOps/SRE, managing MT4/MT5 environments primarily hosted on AWS.
In this role, you will collaborate closely with trading, risk, operations, and engineering teams to maintain high availability trading systems, support integrations with liquidity providers and internal systems, and continuously improve platform reliability. Your expertise in MetaTrader ecosystems and trading infrastructure will help sustain a secure and scalable trading platform.

How You’ll Make an Impact
MetaTrader Platform Ownership
•
Install, configure, and maintain MT4/MT5 servers (live, demo, and test) across AWS or other infrastructure environments.
•
Manage MetaTrader Admin/Manager terminals, including trading accounts, groups, permissions, and trading instrument configurations.
•
Support plugins, liquidity bridges, and trading integrations, working with trading and risk teams to implement new CFDs and trading conditions.
Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Management
•
Implement monitoring and alerting for platform health, latency, connectivity, and trading performance indicators.
•
Investigate and resolve platform incidents such as disconnects, abnormal trading activity, and system instability.

Manage backups, snapshots, and infrastructure performance tuning to ensure system stability and availability.

Collaborate with engineering teams to implement Infrastructure-as-Code and secure infrastructure practices.
Integration & Ecosystem Support
•
Support integrations between MetaTrader and internal systems such as back office, CRM, client portals, and reporting tools.
•
Assist with connectivity to liquidity providers, trading bridges, and FIX integrations.
•
Work with developers and quant teams to deploy and test Expert Advisors (EAs), plugins, and custom components.
Platform Operations & Continuous Improvement
•
Maintain separate environments (dev, test, demo, live) with structured change and release processes.
•
Plan and execute platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes with minimal disruption to trading operations.
•
Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and documentation while applying DevOps/SRE practices to improve reliability.

•
1–4 years of experience working with MetaTrader platforms (MT4 and/or MT5).
•
Experience in brokerage, liquidity provider, prop trading, or trading technology environments.
•
Hands-on experience supporting production trading platforms and operational environments.
•
Experience using MetaTrader Admin/Manager terminals for account, group, and symbol management.
•
Strong knowledge of configuring trading conditions such as leverage, margin, commissions, swaps, and spreads.
•
Experience troubleshooting plugins, bridges, and trading platform integrations.
•
Experience with Windows Server administration for MetaTrader environments and basic Linux support.
•
Familiarity with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, VPC networking, and security groups.
•
Basic scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
•
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, particularly in time-sensitive trading environments.
•
Good communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams including trading, risk, and engineering.
•
Willingness to participate in on-call support during critical trading periods.

Your X-Factor
•
Experience managing MetaTrader environments on AWS production infrastructure.
•
Exposure to other trading platforms such as Match-Trader, cTrader, or similar systems.
•
Familiarity with MQL4/MQL5, Expert Advisors, and trading automation logic.
•
Knowledge of FIX protocol, liquidity connectivity, and trade routing mechanisms.

Experience supporting risk management systems and liquidity bridges.

Understanding of trading platform ecosystem architecture and data flows.

Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, CloudWatch, or ELK.

At My Funded Futures, we’re transforming the world of proprietary trading by giving traders the capital, tools, and community they need to succeed.

We blend innovation, transparency, and performance to create opportunity — helping traders scale faster and smarter. If you’re passionate about fintech, financial markets, and data-driven growth, you’ll fit right in.

Explore our open roles below and see how you can help us shape the future of funded trading.
Position Summary

Join MyFundedFutures as the next QA Engineer responsible for ensuring that every release that reaches production meets a high bar for quality, stability, and correctness. This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You are the gate between code-complete and thousands of users.

You will work closely with product and engineering to define acceptance criteria, have thorough manual test and debugging skills, own the staging environment, build and maintain automation coverage and drive a culture where quality is everyone's responsibility and QA is the last line of defence, not an afterthought.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the QA gate for every release - nothing reaches production without the QA sign-off.

• Radiate knowledge of the trading products and asset classes the platform supports — including equities, futures, and leveraged instruments — so that test coverage reflects real-world user behavior, risk scenarios, and edge cases that matter in live trading environments.

• Stay current with changes to supported asset classes, new product offerings, and evolving platform capabilities; proactively update test plans and regression coverage as the product horizon expands.

• Execute end-to-end regression across all release tickets, verifying against defined acceptance criteria.

• Conduct production smoke tests of every production deploy, validating critical paths are intact.

• Maintain a stable, predictable Staging environment that PM and product can rely on for UAT.

• Build, maintain, and extend the automated regression suite covering critical user journeys: account creation, trading flows, payouts, and authentication.

• Own E2E test coverage; partner with developers on integration and API test coverage.

• Integrate regression suites into CI pipelines so every RC build is automatically validated before manual testing begins.

• Drive automation coverage toward a state where manual regression is focused on new features, not re-testing known-good functionality.

• File all bugs in Jira with clear reproduction steps, environment details as defined.

• Triage and prioritise incoming bugs; communicate release-blocking issues to the product engineering team.

• RanWork with developers during code review to ensure testability, meaningful test coverage, and that new features include adequate unit and integration tests before reaching QA.

• Support PM UAT on Staging - answer environment questions, provide test data, and reproduce issues on demand.

• Maintain test plans, test case documentation, and regression checklists as the authoritative QA reference.

• Document recurring issues, environment quirks, and common failure patterns so knowledge is not locked in one person.

Qualifications

Required

• Working knowledge of trading markets and financial instruments, including equities, futures, and leveraged asset classes. You understand how these products behave, what failure modes look like from a trader's perspective, and why accuracy and timing are non-negotiable in a live trading context.

• Proven experience as a QA Engineer on web and/or mobile software products with a structured, process-driven approach to release quality.

• Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated E2E test suites using frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or similar.

• Solid understanding of the full QA lifecycle: test planning, regression execution, bug management, environment ownership, and release sign-off.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and the ability to integrate test suites into automated build and release workflows.

• Experience with Jira or similar for bug tracking and release management

• Strong written communication skills - clear, precise bug reports and sign-off documentation are non-negotiable.

• Ability to work autonomously and alongside a team

• Reliable and thorough - you follow through, you don't rubber-stamp, and you treat the QA gate as a genuine responsibility.

Preferred

• Experience with React Native and/or Next.js web applications - familiarity with both mobile and web testing contexts.

• Background in fintech, trading platforms, or other regulated/high-stakes software environments where production quality is not negotiable.

• Experience with API testing tools (Postman or similar) and a solid understanding of REST and WebSocket APIs.

• Exposure to mobile testing via TestFlight and device-based regression for React Native applications.

• Familiarity with NX monorepos and multi-environment deployment pipelines (dev, staging, production).

• Experience maintaining QA documentation in Confluence or similar knowledge bases.

• Comfort operating across multiple products or teams simultaneously, helping manage parallel release cycles with independent cadences.

EEO Statement

Equal Employment Opportunity
My Funded Futures is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported—regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Pay Transparency

In compliance with pay transparency laws, My Funded Futures provides compensation ranges in job postings where required. Final compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and location. We also offer comprehensive benefits and performance-based incentives.

Accessibility / Accommodation Statement

If you require assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please contact our HR team at careers@myfundedfutures.com.

Work Authorization

About us

Bitget is one of the world's leading digital assets ecosystems. With over 120 million registered users, Bitget has one of the most comprehensive suites of blockchain products and services available via bitget.com.

Our mission is to support the growth of the digital assets industry and we believe it represents the future of finance. What we do empowers the future of finance by ensuring secure, efficient and smart digital transactions.

We are one of the fastest growing companies in the digital asset sector. If you are looking for cutting-edge work, where you will have opportunities to develop your career among peers who are experts in their field, and you believe in the future of digital currency, then look no further than Bitget!

What you'll do

Payments & Settlement
• Oversee the accurate and timely processing, settlement, and reconciliation of payments.
• Act as the primary liaison with banking partners to resolve day-to-day operational matters.

Cash & Liquidity Management
• Develop short-term cash flow forecasts and oversee daily cash management within the Group's liquidity framework.
• Facilitate the management of intercompany loans, settlements, and accrued interest.

Bank Account Management
• Drive the end-to-end onboarding of new bank accounts, including the administration of online banking platforms and maintenance of authorized signatories.
• Uphold bank mandates and proactively monitor covenant compliance.
• Own and manage the full lifecycle of the bank account opening process, including the preparation, compilation, and submission of required documentation such as KYC/KYB packages and corporate credentials.
• Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Finance teams to ensure all banking onboarding requirements are fulfilled accurately and within established timelines.
• Serve as the key point of contact for banking institutions throughout the account opening and onboarding journey.
• Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date records of all bank account applications, approvals, and related correspondence.
• Support the periodic review, renewal, and optimization of banking relationships and associated documentation.

What you'll need

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline.
• 2–5 years of hands-on experience in treasury or liquidity management within a corporate or financial institution.
• Proven track record in managing bank account opening processes across multiple jurisdictions is a strong advantage.
• Proficient in English & Mandarin to communicate with Chinese speaking stakeholders
• Job Location: Fully onsite, open for local / PR only

Technical Skills
• Solid understanding of international fiat payment rails and local payment schemes (e.g., Faster Payments, SEPA).
• Working knowledge of wire transfers, payment processing, and cash and liquidity management principles.
• Experience with Treasury Management Systems (TMS); familiarity with EMI or payment products is highly desirable.
• Knowledge of Crypto and Blockchain ecosystems is an added advantage.

Soft Skills & Other Requirements
• Proven ability to perform and adapt in a fast-paced, multicultural fintech environment.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Chinese for effective stakeholder engagement.
• Flexibility to occasionally work within the UTC+2~3 timezone to facilitate banking transactions.
• Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and documentation capabilities.
• Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple bank onboarding initiatives concurrently.

Why Bitget?

• Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
• We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
• We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
• We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
• We offer competitive salaries and benefits
• Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!

If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

Are you looking for the next professional opportunity, that will challenge you and advance your career? Join our team now!

Tickmill is looking to hire an AI Platform Administrator to join our rapidly expanding team.

About the Role
We are looking for a mid-to-senior AI Platform Administrator to own the day-to-day administration of our enterprise AI tools and to turn AI prototypes into secure, maintainable, production-ready solutions.
You will administer our Enterprise AI tools across the organization, and you will take AI automation prototypes (agents, LLM workflows, integrations) and harden, package and document them so they can run reliably on our cloud platforms. Once a solution is live, you maintain, monitor and improve it.
This role suits an engineer who enjoys making things work properly in production, and who cares about reliability, security, access control and clean documentation.

About Tickmill.

Tickmill is an award-winning, multi-regulated broker offering access to a broad range of asset classes, including CFDs on Forex, Stocks, Indices, Commodities, Cryptocurrencies, and Bonds, as well as Exchange Traded Derivatives like Futures & Options).

Founded in 2014, the Tickmill Group employs over 330 professionals across offices in London, Cyprus, Poland, Estonia, Seychelles and several other locations worldwide.

Our culture is built on trust, transparency, and high standards.  We bring together ambitious professionals who are looking for an environment that supports them to dominate in their fields.

Our diverse, multilingual teams are focused on innovation, delivering bold excellence, and raising the bar wherever we can.

We offer competitive benefits packages, frequent team initiatives, and opportunities for professional growth.

What does the role look like?

• Administer our enterprise AI platforms: user and licence management, access policies, security and data-handling settings, usage and cost monitoring, and first-line support for users.

• Manage LLM provider accounts, API keys, model versions and quotas, and keep prompt and configuration changes versioned and auditable.

• Review AI prototypes and judge whether they are ready for production.

• Refactor prototype code into maintainable, tested, documented services, mainly in Python.

• Make each solution enterprise-ready: authentication and access control, secrets management, error handling, logging and monitoring, rate limiting and cost controls.

• Containerize solutions (Docker) and prepare for deployment on our cloud platform.

• Integrate AI solutions securely with internal systems and third-party tools such as CRM, Jira, data warehouses and internal APIs.

• Monitor solutions in production (performance, accuracy, cost, failures), troubleshoot incidents and roll out fixes and model updates.

• Set up and maintain evaluation and regression testing so that prompt or model changes don’t quietly break behaviour.

• Ensure solutions meet our data privacy, security and regulatory requirements, working with Compliance, InfoSec and Data teams.

• Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, user guides and internal AI usage guidelines.

What do you need to succeed in this role?

• Experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps or IT systems engineering, with production systems you have maintained yourself.

• Hands-on experience administering enterprise SaaS or AI platforms (e.g. Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot or Azure OpenAI), including user, license and policy management.

• Strong Python skills, plus experience with REST APIs, webhooks and system integrations.

• Hands-on experience deploying and operating LLM-based applications, such as RAG pipelines, agents, or tool and function calling.

• Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD and Kubernetes concepts. You don’t need to run the cluster, but you must deliver workloads that run well on one.

• Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• A strong grasp of production practices: logging, monitoring, testing, versioning, secrets management and security.

• Ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and to push back constructively when something isn’t ready for production.

• A structured, documentation-minded approach and a high level of ownership.

Will be considered a plus:

• Experience with AWS Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID administration.

• Experience in FinTech, brokerage, banking or another regulated industry.

• Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar) and vector databases.

• Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g. Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize).

• Experience with MCP servers, Claude Code or similar developer AI tooling.

• Knowledge of workflow automation tools (n8n, Make, Power Automate) and business systems such as Jira and HubSpot.

• Understanding of data governance, GDPR and AI risk management.

By joining us, you can expect:

• Unique Opportunity for a career in a global, fast-growing company.

• Attractive remuneration package based on qualifications and experience (including 13th salary and Discretionary Bonuses to reward exceptional performance).

• Opportunities to learn and grow through our “Employee Training & Development program”.

• Medical Insurance Cover, which includes Outpatient, Inpatient, and Dental Care.

• Multiple events to bond with the team and the group through Quarterly/Semestrial Team Activities for all the Company.

• Participation in our welfare investment and savings plan through our Provident Fund Scheme.

• Birthday and Loyalty benefits.

• Collaboration with SportBenefit.

Make your next Career step and apply NOW!

*Due to the great number of applications, we receive for each of our open vacancies, we are unable to respond on an individual basis.

The future of finance in the Philippines is about more than just crypto—it's about how people get paid, send money, accept payments, and access financial services seamlessly. Who We're Looking For
•

We are looking for a Senior Web Designer who combines strong visual craft and product thinking to design high-converting web experiences that drive measurable acquisition results. You will join our Brand Design team, working side by side with graphic, motion and 3d designers to shape how our brand lives on the web, and collaborate closely with product/marketing managers, analysts, and developers, where modern web design directly shapes how potential users discover our product and decide to sign up.

In this role, you will design and optimize our key acquisition surfaces (websites and landing pages), conduct qualitative research to understand visitor behavior, and translate insights into design improvements. You will set the visual direction for our web presence, influence design decisions, shape the brand experience on the web, and deliver measurable results for both the people who use our product and the company.

Responsibilities

• Design and evolve our key company websites with strong visual craft, with hand-off to WordPress developers for our main sites and to frontend developers for custom-built landings

• Design and continuously optimize landing pages and key website pages, focusing on clarity of message, engagement, and conversion to sign-up

• Build user flow maps and user journey maps to visualize and improve the acquisition experience end to end

• Conduct qualitative user research, including session recording analysis, heatmap reviews, user interviews, and usability testing, to uncover insights and inform design decisions

• Create app store creatives, including screenshots, feature graphics, and listing assets for App Store and Google Play

• Compose visually compelling layouts with strong typography, hierarchy, and visual rhythm

• Collaborate with graphic, 3D designers and other creative team members to integrate brand illustrations, photography, and visual assets into web layouts

• Adapt designs for multiple regions and languages, ensuring layouts, typography, and content systems work effectively across different markets and locales

• Ensure accessibility and responsiveness across different devices, adhering to brand guidelines and the web design system

• Document design decisions and guidelines for accurate implementation

Requirements

• 4+ years of experience designing landing pages, marketing websites, and registration flows

• Background that includes hands-on work with conversion metrics, A/B tests, qualitative research, and cross-functional collaboration with product managers and analysts

• Portfolio with recent (last 1 to 2 years) landing pages, marketing websites,home pages and registration flows demonstrating modern visual craft and conversion-focused thinking

• Strong visual design skills (typography, color theory, layout, hierarchy, composition) with a clear sense of modern web design trends and references

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) for visual design, asset preparation, and image editing

• Hands-on experience improving registration and sign-up flows by identifying friction through qualitative research and shipping iterative improvements

• Experience designing for acquisition, growth, or conversion-focused contexts with measurable impact

• Good qualitative research skills, including session recording analysis, heatmap interpretation, user interviews, and usability testing, with the ability to translate observations into actionable design hypotheses

• Proficiency in building user flow maps and user journey maps to visualize and communicate complex flows

• Experience creating app store creatives (screenshots, feature graphics, listing assets) for App Store and Google Play, with familiarity with ASO visual best practices

• Practical experience designing for both WordPress (page builders like Elementor or Gutenberg, reusable block patterns, dynamic content) and custom frontend hand-off, with basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for effective collaboration with developers across both stacks

• Proficiency in designing responsive user interfaces for web and mobile, grounded in user-centered design principles and information architecture

• Experience working within established design systems (components, tokens, guidelines) and proficiency in Figma for prototyping and rapid iteration

• Experience designing for multi-language and multi-regional products, with understanding of how localization affects layout, typography, content density, and visual hierarchy

• Proficient English skills (B2+ level) both written and spoken, with strong communication, teamwork, and a user-focused mindset with attention to detail

Will be a plus

• Experience working with FinTech products

• Illustration skills, with the ability to create custom illustrations or thoughtfully compose layouts using existing illustration assets

• Experience designing gamification mechanics

• Experience creating microinteractions and lightweight UI animations (Lottie, After Effects, Rive, or similar tools)

• Experience using AI-powered tools (Midjourney, Krea, Runway, Figma AI plugins, Claude, or similar) in your design workflow

We offer

• 10 paid sick leave days per year

• Public holidays as per the company's approved Public holiday list

• Medical insurance

• Opportunity to work remotely

• Professional education budget

• Language learning budget

• Wellness budget (gym membership, sports gear and related expenses)

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

Responsibilities

• Payment System Development: Design, develop, and optimize OKX Pay's payment backend systems; build highly available, high-concurrency, scalable payment infrastructure.

• Scan-to-Pay Capabilities: Contribute to core QR/scan-to-pay functionality across the critical path — payment code generation, scan recognition, order creation, payment confirmation, state transitions, timeout handling, risk-control validation, and exception compensation.

• Transaction Processing & Fund Flows: Design and implement secure, stable transaction processing systems covering orders, payments, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, refunds, and callback notifications.

• Crypto & Stablecoin Payments: Build crypto and stablecoin payment capabilities — on-chain transfers, transaction confirmation, address management, asset crediting, and payment-status synchronization — and integrate them with traditional payment experiences.

• System Stability & Problem Solving: Safeguard the stability of core payment flows; diagnose and resolve complex production issues including performance bottlenecks, data-consistency problems, fund-security risks, and abnormal transaction scenarios.

• Technical Optimization & Engineering Quality: Continuously improve system architecture, code quality, monitoring and alerting, exception compensation, and observability to raise the security, reliability, and maintainability of the payment system.

Requirements

• Java Backend Experience: Solid Java development skills, fluent in Spring Boot and mainstream Java backend frameworks, with experience building high-concurrency, high-availability systems.

• Payments Domain Experience: Hands-on experience with payment systems and their core flows — payment orders, payment state machines, callback notifications, reconciliation, refunds, clearing/settlement, and exception compensation.

• Scan-to-Pay Experience: Background in scan-to-pay, acquiring, aggregated payments, merchant payments, wallet payments, or similar products, with familiarity across the full business and technical chain.

• System Design: Strong architecture design ability, capable of designing reliable transaction paths, state-transition mechanisms, and idempotency, retry, and compensation mechanisms.

• Data Consistency & Fund-Security Awareness: Understanding of the importance of data consistency, transaction handling, idempotency, deduplication, concurrency protection, risk-control validation, and fund security in payment systems.

• Crypto / Stablecoin Payment Understanding: Familiarity with the fundamentals of crypto and stablecoin payments and on-chain asset movement, including on-chain transfers, transaction confirmation, address systems, Gas, and crediting confirmation.

• Problem-Solving: Able to independently troubleshoot complex production issues, with strong log analysis, tracing, performance-optimization, and recovery skills.

• Ownership & Execution: Strong ownership; able to drive problems to resolution and ship projects in a fast-changing environment.

Nice-to-Haves

• Stablecoin Payment Experience: Project experience with USDT, USDC, or other stablecoin payments, collection, settlement, crediting, or on-chain confirmation.

• Scan-to-Pay / Acquiring Experience: QR payments, merchant acquiring, aggregated payments, payment gateways, cross-border payments, or offline payment scenarios.

• Account & Ledger Systems: Experience with payment accounts, fund accounts, merchant accounts, ledger systems, clearing/settlement systems, or reconciliation systems.

• Blockchain Fundamentals: Familiarity with the transaction mechanisms, address models, and asset-transfer flows of EVM, Tron, Solana, or other mainstream chains.

• Risk & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of payment risk control, anti-fraud, limits, allow/deny lists, KYC/KYT, and AML mechanisms.

• High-Concurrency Transaction Systems: Experience building high-concurrency order systems, trading systems, payment gateways, acquiring systems, or finance-grade core systems.

Who You Are

• A solid Java backend engineer with deep understanding of payment systems, especially scan-to-pay, acquiring, merchant payments, or wallet payments.

• You care not only about shipping features but also about fund security, system stability, exception compensation, reconciliation consistency, and the user's payment experience.

• You don't need to be a senior blockchain expert, but you have a basic grasp of crypto and stablecoin payments and are eager to explore new payment models that combine traditional payment experiences with on-chain assets.

Competitive total compensation

Comprehensive insurance coverage for employees and their dependants

More that we love to tell you along the process!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Trading to own trading products on the Crypto.com App end-to-end. Retail trading is where users feel the product every day - and where volume, engagement, and retention compound. Every improvement you ship shows up in how people trade, how often they come back, and how Crypto.com wins share in a crowded market.
Your mandate is to drive trading products from discovery through launch and iteration: roadmap clarity, feature definition, customer insight, and shipping at global scale. 
You will run your roadmap with independence within Trading's strategic priorities. You prioritize initiatives, cut tradeoffs, and make the call on what ships when. You report to the Senior Director of Product Management, who sets strategic direction. You own the how and the when.

• Cut the hard tradeoffs. You weigh speed vs. depth, retail clarity vs. power-user needs, and compliance constraints vs. product ambition- and you own the decision.

• Drive market and competitive clarity. You run the research that informs what we build next. Your work shows up in the roadmap, not a slide deck that dies in a folder.

• Represent Trading across the company. You are the DRI in cross-functional forums with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Compliance, and Growth. Alignment is your job; escalation is the exception.

• Own a defined slice of the trading product line. Features in your charter are yours from inception through post-launch iteration. Ownership isn't shipping tickets- it's delivering outcomes.

• Crypto and/or perpetuals build experience. You have shipped trading products in crypto and/or perpetuals (not just adjacent fintech). You can point to what you owned, what you launched, and what moved- volume, adoption, retention, or risk/UX outcomes- and what you did when the market or the product broke your assumptions.

• Shipped software or financial products at scale. You have owned customer-facing products end-to-end and can describe a time you coordinated design, eng, and GTM through a launch- and what you did when dependencies slipped.

• Data-informed, user-obsessed. You instrument your own funnel, size opportunities, and prioritize without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis- always through a compassionate lens of the trader.

• Cross-functional leadership without authority. You can describe a time you aligned Design, Engineering, QA, Marketing, Compliance, and Growth toward a ship date, and how you unblocked the team when it stalled.

• AI-native workflow. You demonstrably use AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, LibreChat, or equivalent) with human-in-the-loop judgment. Required, not optional. We care what you've built and owned- not pedigree checkboxes.

Preferred:
• Stocks, tokenized stocks, and/or options: Hands-on product or market knowledge that accelerates expansion beyond core crypto trading.

• Global consumer product: You've launched and iterated across regions with different regulatory and UX constraints.

Direct product impact. Trading sits on the critical path of how 80M+ users experience Crypto.com. Your work shows up in the numbers.

Frontier of retail crypto. Spot, perpetuals, and the next wave of markets- the playbook isn't finished. You'll write parts of it.

Autonomy with teeth. You own the roadmap and ship decisions inside a clear strategic frame. Access to the teams that matter. No theater.

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

募集背景
ビットバンクは「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに、暗号資産取引所サービスを提供しています。
暗号資産取引所は金融サービスとしてセキュリティや可用性が最重要ですが、インターネットサービスとしてスピードや柔軟性も求められます。
プロダクト開発を担う組織の一つであるリテールシステム部では、暗号資産取引所のうち多くのお客様が直接手に触れるモバイルアプリやWebフロントエンドをはじめとして、それらを支えるバックエンドAPIやサービスも含めたお客様向けの機能全体（=リテールシステム）を開発・運用しています。
このようなチャレンジングな環境で、お客様に最高の暗号資産取引体験を提供するために、一緒に奮闘してくれる仲間を募集しています。

• 暗号資産取引所サービスの新機能追加に関わる設計・実装

• 各種定性(ユーザー要望、社内要望など)・定量情報(ログ分析、データ分析など)に基づくUI/UXの改善

• 問い合わせ・脆弱性報告・不具合報告への対応とCX・営業との連携

• PdM・デザイナー・PMと連携したプロジェクト進行

• カンファレンス及びイベント等への登壇・寄稿、エンジニアの採用(希望に応じて)

TMGM is a leading global financial services provider, specializing in Contracts for Difference (CFD) trading and offering innovative trading solutions across various asset classes, including equities, forex, and commodities. We are committed to delivering exceptional client experiences and driving business growth through professional expertise and cutting-edge technology.

About the Role
This role is responsible for developing and managing end-to-end media strategies to generate quality leads, drive registrations, and increase active user engagement. The role involves optimizing campaigns daily to meet key KPIs (CPL, CVR, CPC, CPA) and ensuring strong ROAS.
Works closely with cross-functional teams to define target audiences, enhance campaign performance, and identify new MarTech tools for better insights. Continuously analyzes data, tests new approaches, and improves user conversion and overall digital journey.

Key responsibilities
• Devise and manage end-to-end Media plan & strategy to raise quality leads, drive registrants and drive continuous usage as active users
• Bidding & Optimizing media campaigns to drive conversion on a daily basis to closely monitor ROAS (i.e. CPL, CVR, CPC, CPA) to achieve each business goal
• Measure & Report media performance against KPIs & recommendations to relate parties as a weekly basis to enhance campaign communication & creative materials effectiveness
• Be an audience master who works with Data Analysis, Business Development, Marketing campaigns, and Marketing Communication to define the potential customer segments among several ads platforms and owned media channels to maximize the conversion rate efficacy
• Monitor digital customer behavior and Identify new MarTech tools to gather online marketing insight, performance analytic thought in the digital landscape, and mobile-app marketing
• Identify initiatives & techniques for improving KPI performance and operation process including A/B Testing, Multivariate testing, customer attribution model, and retargeting multi-touch journey to enforce the best practices
• Track and analyze site traffic flow/ performance indicators, provide regular internal reports, and identify improvement areas such as reducing the drop-off rate, in-active cause, and improving customer experience for quick conversion of each customer journey

Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
• 2–5 years of experience in performance marketing, ads optimization, media buying, or digital marketing.
• Hands-on experience with performance media channels such as Facebook Ads, Google Ads, SEM, SEO, LINE Ads, TikTok Ads, Twitter Ads, Native Ads, Audience Ad Network, and other biddable or non-biddable platforms.
• Experience in the finance industry is an added advantage.
• Strong command of English, both written and spoken.

募集背景
ビットバンクのミッション「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」に共感できる仲間を募集しています。
ビットバンクでは、在宅勤務を導入する等、柔軟な働き方を推進しています。
コンプライアンスは、漠然と「法令遵守」のことと認識されている時代もありましたが、現在はもっと広い意味で用いられるようになり、企業倫理等の社会的なルールとして守るべきだと認識されているものを、幅広く含む概念となってきました。
暗号資産の社会的認知度の向上に伴い、事業者に求められるコンプライアンスの水準も日々高まっています。また、技術的なイノベーション等により経営環境が急速に変化し、新たなサービスや取引手法・取引形態が登場することで、コンプライアンス上のリスクも増大します。
その為、暗号資産交換業（取引所・販売所の運営）に関する業規制を基盤としつつ、ビジネスモデルの多様化・複雑化の折には、銀行法、信託法、金融商品取引法、貸金業法、資金決済法（資金移動業、前払式支払手段）といった他の業規制への対応も、常に視野に入れておくことが重要です。
これらに対し、最適な内部管理態勢をどのように構築・運用するか、守り（事業継続）と攻め（事業成長の支援）双方の視点を持った方からのエントリーをお待ちしております。

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

募集背景
ビットバンクのミッション「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」に共感できる仲間を募集しています。
弊社は暗号資産取引所サービスを提供しています。
暗号資産取引所は金融サービスとして、セキュリティや可用性が最重要ですが、インターネットサービスとしてスピードや柔軟性も求められるという特徴があります。
プロダクト開発を担う組織の一つであるリテールシステム部では、暗号資産取引所のうち多くのお客様が直接手に触れるモバイルアプリやWebフロントエンドをはじめとして、それらを支えるバックエンドAPIやサービスも含めたお客様向けの機能全体（=リテールシステム）を開発・運用しています。
チャレンジングな環境で、お客様に最高の暗号資産取引体験を提供するために、一緒に奮闘してくれる仲間を募集しています。

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Security is fundamental to the trust millions of customers place in Bitpanda every day. As an Cyber Security Engineer, you'll help protect our platform by detecting threats, responding to incidents and continuously improving the security of our cloud-native environment. Working alongside experienced security engineers, you'll build detections, automate repetitive tasks and investigate security events that help keep our infrastructure, applications and customers safe.

What you'll do

• Build and improve detections. Develop, test and tune detection rules in Elastic Security (ES|QL/KQL), helping improve detection coverage, reduce false positives and ensure meaningful threats are identified quickly.

• Investigate security events and hunt for threats. Respond to security alerts, participate in incident response, perform proactive threat hunting across AWS, Elastic and Datadog, and contribute to improving investigation and response processes.

• Automate security operations. Build scripts, API integrations and SOAR workflows that reduce manual effort, improve investigation quality and help the Security team operate more efficiently.

• Help secure our cloud platform. Monitor AWS security events, investigate suspicious activity, contribute to system hardening and security tooling improvements, and support initiatives that strengthen Bitpanda's overall security posture.

• Contribute to a strong security culture. Work closely with engineers across the business, support compliance activities including ISO 27001, PCI DSS and DORA, and help promote security best practices throughout the organisation.

• Keep millions of users safe, no matter the time of day. As part of this commitment, you'll participate in a weekly rotating on-call schedule alongside the rest of the team.

Who you are

• You have 2–4 years of experience in information security, security engineering or security operations, with exposure to incident response, SIEM, threat hunting or cloud security.

• You enjoy solving technical security problems and have experience writing scripts or automating workflows using APIs or security tooling.

• You have a solid understanding of AWS or another major cloud platform, networking fundamentals, system hardening and security monitoring. Experience with Elastic Security, ES|QL or KQL is a big plus!

• You're curious, proactive and eager to learn, taking ownership of your work while seeking opportunities to improve both security and operational efficiency.

• You're passionate about keeping millions of users safe, no matter the time of day; This role has on call responsibilities that rotate through the team on a weekly basis.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Your mission:

As an AML & KYC Operations Associate at Bitpanda, your mission is to actively contribute to the mitigation of money laundering and terrorist financing risks. You will ensure compliance with applicable regulations in the anti-financial crime field, demonstrating a strong commitment to preventing financial crimes perpetrated within the cryptocurrency environment. You possess a robust problem-solving and customer-oriented mindset.

What you’ll do:

• Perform day-to-day reviews for Source of Funds (SoF) and/or Source of Wealth (SoW), primarily focusing on fiat transactions and low-risk customers. You will diligently oversee customers’ financial activities and identify any potential red flags on users’ accounts.

• Analyze retail users’ financial data and their provided explanations. You will directly interact with customers to request any necessary additional documents.

• Conduct regular transaction monitoring reviews to assess if a follow-up PoF/PoW is required, always balancing the overall customer experience with strict adherence to regulatory requirements.

• Perform PEP, RCA and SIP screening reviews by assessing potential matches on politically exposed persons, their relatives and close associates, and special interest persons.

Who you are:

• Education: University degree in Economics, Finance, or Law.

• Skills: Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Knowledge: Demonstrated interest in AML regulation (e.g., the AML Directives, the FM-GwG, the ESAs AML/CFT Guidelines) with a comprehensive understanding of different financial crime patterns and the broader AML/CFT landscape.

• Industry Interest: A keen interest in the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency industry.

Please Note: This is an evening shift position (from 3:30 PM until midnight) for either a Tuesday to Saturday or Sunday to Thursday schedule.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

TMGM stands at the forefront of online trading and investment services, proudly serving as Chelsea FC's Official Regional Online Forex and Trading Partner in Asia Pacific. With a global presence and offices spanning three continents, TMGM has earned its reputation as a trusted CFD trading provider. We embody excellence through a commitment to regulatory compliance, technological innovation, and unparalleled customer service.

At TMGM, our vision goes beyond providing a platform for trading; we aspire to empower our clients with the best trading conditions. We leverage industry-leading and cutting-edge innovative platforms to ensure that your trading experience is nothing short of exceptional. Our relentless commitment to research and development continually pushes the boundaries of liquidity and usability, giving them the tools they need to thrive in an ever-evolving financial landscape.

About the Job
As our business expands rapidly through regional growth, we seek a passionate and experienced Account Manager to join our incredible team. If you are dedicated to a long-term financial career in this industry, TMGM provides the perfect platform for success. Regardless of your location, if you are eager to be part of our unique and growing team, seize this opportunity and apply now!

Your Impact and Contribution

As an Account Manager at TMGM, your primary focus will be driving sales for our products and services. You will be able to provide clients with exceptional service across all communication channels. Your role will involve the following:
Sales Growth:
• Assist in driving sales by promoting and selling TMGM's products and services.
• You can independently use your strong sales skills to identify and generate client pipelines.
• Build and nurture relationships with new clients to foster long-term partnerships.
Client Service:
• Deliver exceptional customer service across various communication channels to ensure client satisfaction.
• Please respond quickly and professionally to client inquiries, and resolve issues effectively.
Performance and Goal Orientation:
• Work towards specific Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to meet or exceed sales targets.
• Please expand your knowledge about the markets, FX industry, and TMGM's platforms and products.
• Strive to achieve team and individual metrics, contributing to overall success.

• We seek highly motivated individuals to kick-start or advance their careers in the Forex industry-minimum one year of experience in the Forex industry. Previous exposure to customer-focused environments such as customer services, sales, outbound/inbound support, consulting, or similar fields would be advantageous. Great willingness to learn practical financial knowledge and professional skills.
• Comfortable making high outbound calls and engaging with diverse buyers. You should possess confident communication skills or be motivated to enhance your communication abilities.
• Strong ownership of your responsibilities. You are proactive in addressing challenges, displaying a problem-solving mindset. You are a diligent worker, driven to achieve results, fearless when faced with obstacles, and hungry to start a rewarding career.
• Excellent overall communication abilities, including modifying approaches to suit various audiences.
• Proﬁciency in English and Mandarin are highly preferred.
Benefits
• Experience a unique work culture that thrives on high performance, where you can gain valuable experience and achieve remarkable success.
• We offer competitive salary packages and an enticing commission structure with truly uncapped earning potential.
• Both part-time and full-time options, allow you to tailor your work arrangement to fit your lifestyle.
• Investing in your growth and development is our priority. We offer ongoing training and support, equipping you with the tools and knowledge needed to excel in your role.
